purpose: Complete original presentation timestamp metadata for sampling feasibility, not feature extraction or scientific gate acceptance
activation_requires: Recorded authorization for this exact batch and adopted contract version
Reconciled remaining cumulative budget and actual current rate, or explicit batch allowance resolving RS00 for this scope
Frozen source manifest, origin identities, source hashes, sampling order and acquisition code hash
No conflicting running job; use only the existing authorized instance
Review parent task evidence and required pass gates; no automatic formal-training release

inputs.selection: One representative per known origin group, sorted by frozen SHA256 identifier; first five per source, selected before observing timing or detection scores
inputs.unknown_ancestry: Keep explicit flag; do not call candidate origins independent or accepted

operations.note: Future ffprobe may decode internally; CPU-only does not mean zero provider charges. No probe command was run in this work package.

required: source_sha256 with pre/post size and mtime consistency
all frame integer pts and pts_time when available
all frame duration fields when available
source processing provenance and acquisition timestamps
metadata.serialization: JSON or compressed JSON; never pickle

stopping.normal: Finish the approved finite batch, hash and synchronize compact receipts, verify no active jobs, then apply the authorized shutdown arrangement and verify shutdown
stopping.budget: Before each next file reserve a conservative completion allowance; stop admission if insufficient. Unexpected resource exhaustion records a resumable partial acquisition, not invalid video
stopping.storage_or_stall: Stop admission and preserve partial outputs; classify as acquisition/resource failure, never silently exclude or claim complete EOF

acceptance_scope.required_report: Per-source completeness and coverage, continuous joint lags, errors/phase/span, unresolved provenance, actual elapsed billing exposure and costs if verified
